brief.claim: Among patients whose symptom score at the screening visit was at least 60, at least 40% improve by 10 points or more between the start of the programme and the 6-month follow-up (score at the start minus score at 6 months of at least 10); the claim is that the proportion of such patients is at least 0.40.

data_keys.meaning: symptom score of each patient at the screening visit (higher is worse)
symptom score of each patient at the start of the programme
symptom score of each patient at the 6-month follow-up
